+# Direct Weight Reload
+
+Direct reload updates a running model's weights in place. Set the
+`VLLM_RELOAD_MODE` environment variable to `direct`; the default is
+`layerwise` (see [Layerwise (Re)loading](layerwise.md)).
+
+!!! tip
+    Prefer direct reload for RL weight updates. Use layerwise reload only for
+    the configurations direct reload refuses (see below).
+
+```bash
+VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct vllm serve <model>
+```
+
+## How It Works
+
+- **Cold start** records each tensor's checkpoint layout after loading.
+- **Begin** views every tensor back to its checkpoint layout, in its existing
+  storage.
+- **Load**: the model's weight loaders write the new checkpoint tensors, as at
+  cold start, through `reload_weights` or a checkpoint-format
+  [weight transfer](weight_transfer/README.md) backend.
+- **Finish** reruns the cold-start post-load processing.
+
+No layer is buffered and no tensor changes address, so captured CUDA graphs
+stay valid. Each update must send every weight.
+
+## Online Quantization
+
+[Online quantization](../features/quantization/online.md) works in direct mode.
+Each high-precision tensor is quantized as it is loaded, into the layout of the
+matching pre-quantized checkpoint; the trainer keeps sending BF16 weights under
+their checkpoint names.
+
+```bash
+VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B --quantization fp8_per_block
+```
+
+| `--quantization` | Linear layers | MoE layers |
+| - | - | - |
+| `fp8_per_tensor`, `fp8_per_block`, `fp8_per_channel`, `mxfp8` | Supported | Supported |
+| `mxfp4` (`--quantization-config.moe mxfp4`) | Refused | Supported |
+| `nvfp4_per_token` | Stay BF16 | Supported |
+
+With NVFP4, the w1 and w3 (gate and up) weights of an expert share one global
+scale, so both must arrive in the same update (between one
+`start_weight_update` and `finish_weight_update`), in either order. The first
+of the two is the only tensor direct reload holds: it waits until the second
+arrives, and an update that delivers only one of them fails at finish.
+
+## Refused Configurations
+
+Direct reload raises an error for the following; use
+`VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=layerwise` for them instead:
+
+- Online quantization not in the table above: `mxfp4` and `mxfp4_hadamard32`
+  linear layers, `int8_per_channel_weight_only`, `lut_b_moe`, a quantized
+  lm_head, activation overrides, `hadamard_size`, and re-quantization of
+  checkpoint-quantized layers.
+- gpt-oss models with online quantization.
+- `fp8_per_block` linear layers whose tensor-parallel shards are not
+  multiples of 128.
+- The NCCL weight transfer load plan (`use_load_plan`) with online
+  quantization.
+- `torchao` quantization, Humming kernels, LoRA, weight offloading,
+  `draft_lm_head_quantization`, and the `sharded_rdt` weight transfer backend.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Loaders that quantize each arriving tensor (direct reload of online quant)."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online import loading
+
+
+class _Experts(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Local experts 0 and 1; records what the checkpoint loaders receive."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        self.moe_config = SimpleNamespace(is_act_and_mul=True)
+        self.layer_name = "experts"
+        self.loaded: dict[tuple[str, str, int], torch.Tensor] = {}
+        for p in ("w13_", "w2_"):
+            for n in ("weight", "weight_scale", "weight_scale_2"):
+                param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(0, device="cuda"), False)
+                param.weight_loader = self._load
+                self.register_parameter(p + n, param)
+        self.method = SimpleNamespace(process_weights_after_loading=lambda _: None)
+
+    def _map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id(self, expert_id):
+        return expert_id if expert_id in (0, 1) else -1
+
+    def _load(self, param, loaded_weight, weight_name, shard_id, expert_id, **_):
+        self.loaded[weight_name, shard_id, expert_id] = loaded_weight.clone()
+        return True
+
+    def send(self, shard_id, expert_id, value):
+        # keyword call, as RoutedExperts.load_weights makes it
+        return self.w13_weight.weight_loader(
+            param=self.w13_weight,
+            loaded_weight=torch.full((2, 16), value, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+            weight_name="w13_weight",
+            shard_id=shard_id,
+            expert_id=expert_id,
+            return_success=True,
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def experts(monkeypatch):
+    def quantize(w):  # values, block scales, global scale = amax
+        return w, w, w.abs().amax().reshape(1)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loading, "_quantize_moe_weight_to_nvfp4", quantize)
+    layer = _Experts()
+    loading._nvfp4_on_load(layer, layer.method)
+    return layer
+
+
+class TestNvfp4Pairing:
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "sends,expected",
+        [
+            ([("w1", 1.0), ("w3", 3.0)], {"w1": 1.0, "w3": 3.0}),
+            ([("w3", 3.0), ("w1", 1.0)], {"w1": 1.0, "w3": 3.0}),
+            ([("w1", 9.0), ("w1", 1.0), ("w3", 3.0)], {"w1": 1.0, "w3": 3.0}),
+        ],
+        ids=["w1-first", "w3-first", "stale-half-replaced"],
+    )
+    def test_shared_global_scale(self, experts, sends, expected):
+        for shard_id, value in sends:
+            assert experts.send(shard_id, 0, value)
+        for shard_id, value in expected.items():
+            assert experts.loaded["w13_weight", shard_id, 0].eq(value).all()
+            scale_2 = experts.loaded["w13_weight_scale_2", shard_id, 0]
+            assert scale_2.item() == max(expected.values())
+        experts.method.process_weights_after_loading(experts)
+
+    def test_other_rank_expert_is_not_buffered(self, experts):
+        assert experts.send("w1", 5, 1.0) is False
+        assert not experts.loaded
+        experts.method.process_weights_after_loading(experts)
+
+    def test_lone_half_fails_post_load(self, experts):
+        experts.send("w1", 0, 1.0)
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=r"experts \[0\] got only one"):
+            experts.method.process_weights_after_loading(experts)
+        experts.method.process_weights_after_loading(experts)  # state cleared
+
+
+def test_quantizer_gets_contiguous_tensor():
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    layer.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    layer.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(4, 6, dtype=torch.int8), False)
+    layer.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(()), False)
+
+    def quantize(w):
+        assert w.is_contiguous()
+        return w.to(torch.int8), w.float().abs().amax()
+
+    loading.quantize_on_load(layer, "weight", quantize, "weight_scale")
+    transposed = torch.arange(24, dtype=torch.bfloat16).reshape(6, 4).t()
+    layer.weight.weight_loader(layer.weight, transposed)
+    assert torch.equal(layer.weight, transposed.to(torch.int8))
+    assert layer.weight_scale.item() == 23

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from functools import partial
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online import fp8 as online_fp8
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.nvfp4 import (
+    _quantize_moe_weight_to_nvfp4,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import weight_amax
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+
+
+def _rename(arg: Any, old: str, new: str) -> Any:
+    return arg.replace(old, new) if isinstance(arg, str) else arg
+
+
+def _load_quantized(layer: torch.nn.Module, name: str, *scale_names: str):
+    """Load `(values, *scales)` as a checkpoint of that layout is loaded."""
+    load = getattr(getattr(layer, name), "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+    layer.quantizes_on_load = True
+
+    def load_quantized(param, quantized, *args, **kwargs):
+        values, *scales = quantized
+        for scale_name, scale in zip(scale_names, scales):
+            scale_param = getattr(layer, scale_name)
+            # the MoE loader picks how to load a scale by its parameter name
+            getattr(scale_param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(
+                scale_param,
+                scale,
+                *(_rename(a, name, scale_name) for a in args),
+                **{k: _rename(v, name, scale_name) for k, v in kwargs.items()},
+            )
+        return load(param, values, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    return load_quantized
+
+
+def quantize_on_load(
+    layer: torch.nn.Module, name: str, quantize: Callable, *scale_names: str
+) -> None:
+    """Make quantized `layer.<name>` load high-precision tensors via `quantize`."""
+    load = _load_quantized(layer, name, *scale_names)
+
+    def loader(param, loaded_weight, *args, **kwargs):
+        weight = loaded_weight.to(param.device, layer.params_dtype).contiguous()
+        return load(param, quantize(weight), *args, **kwargs)
+
+    getattr(layer, name).weight_loader = loader
+
+
+def _quantize_fp8_per_channel(weight: torch.Tensor) -> tuple:
+    scale = online_fp8._fp8_channel_scale(weight_amax(weight, dim=-1, keepdim=True))
+    return online_fp8._fp8_quant_per_channel(weight, scale), scale
+
+
+def _nvfp4_on_load(layer: torch.nn.Module, method: Any) -> None:
+    """w1 and w3 of an expert share one global scale: the first waits."""
+    pending: dict[int, tuple[str, torch.Tensor, torch.Event]] = {}
+
+    def loader(load, param, loaded_weight, weight_name, shard_id, expert_id, **kw):
+        if layer._map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id(expert_id) == -1:
+            return False
+        weight = loaded_weight.to(param.device, layer.params_dtype, copy=True)
+        shards = [(shard_id, weight)]
+        if shard_id in ("w1", "w3") and layer.moe_config.is_act_and_mul:
+            first = pending.pop(expert_id, None)
+            if first is None or first[0] == shard_id:
+                copied = torch.Event()
+                copied.record()
+                pending[expert_id] = (shard_id, weight, copied)
+                return True
+            first_id, first_weight, copied = first
+            # held from another load, which may have run on another stream
+            copied.wait()
+            first_weight.record_stream(torch.accelerator.current_stream())
+            shards.insert(0, (first_id, first_weight))
+        stacked = torch.cat([w for _, w in shards])[None]
+        values, scales, scale_2 = _quantize_moe_weight_to_nvfp4(stacked)
+        n = len(shards)
+        for (shard, _), v, s in zip(shards, values[0].chunk(n), scales[0].chunk(n)):
+            ret = load(param, (v, s, scale_2), weight_name, shard, expert_id, **kw)
+        return ret
+
+    for p in ("w13_", "w2_"):
+        names = (f"{p}weight", f"{p}weight_scale", f"{p}weight_scale_2")
+        load = _load_quantized(layer, *names)
+        getattr(layer, names[0]).weight_loader = partial(loader, load)
+
+    process = method.process_weights_after_loading
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        if pending:
+            experts = sorted(pending)
+            pending.clear()
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{layer.layer_name}: NVFP4 experts {experts} got only one of "
+                "w1/w3; both must be loaded in the same update"
+            )
+        process(layer)
+
+    method.process_weights_after_loading = process_weights_after_loading
+
+
+def checkpoint_method(layer: torch.nn.Module, spec: Any, default: Any) -> Any:
+    """The pre-quantized checkpoint method that `spec` stands for, if any."""
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationArgs
+
+    import vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.compressed_tensors_moe.compressed_tensors_moe_w8a8_fp8 as ct_fp8  # noqa: E501
+    import vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.compressed_tensors_moe.compressed_tensors_moe_w8a8_mxfp8 as ct_mxfp8  # noqa: E501
+    from vllm.config.quantization import QuantSpec
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import RoutedExperts
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import fp8, modelopt, mxfp4
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils import mxfp4_utils, mxfp8_utils
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils import quant_utils as qu
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import per_block_cast_to_fp8
+
+    is_moe = isinstance(layer, RoutedExperts)
+    moe: Any = getattr(layer, "moe_config", None)
+    method: Any  # the checkpoint method of the matching pre-quantized scheme
+    quantize: Callable[..., Any]
+    if spec.activation != default or spec.hadamard_size is not None:
+        return None
+    if not (is_moe or isinstance(layer, LinearBase)):
+        return None
+    weight, ckpt = spec.weight, modelopt.CkptCtx()
